mapper.sql: watchlist_id, ticker_symbol, added_at, alert_direction, alert_target_price, alert_status, alert_set_at, alert_triggered_at, alert_trigger_price, alert_delivery
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO watchlist ( watchlist_id, account_id, name, created_at, updated_at ) SELECT CAST(#{watchlist.watchlistId} AS BIGINT), CAST(#{watchlist.accountId} AS BIGINT), CAST(#{watchlist.name} AS VARCHAR), CAST(#{watchlist.createdAt} AS TIMESTAMPTZ), CAST(#{watchlist.updatedAt} AS TIMESTAMPTZ) WHERE ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM watchlist WHERE account_id = #{watchlist.accountId} ) < #{limit}
mapper.select: SELECT watchlist_id, account_id, name, created_at, updated_at FROM watchlist WHERE account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY created_at ASC, watchlist_id ASC
SELECT watchlist_id, account_id, name, created_at, updated_at FROM watchlist WHERE watchlist_id = #{watchlistId}
SELECT watchlist_id, account_id, name, created_at, updated_at FROM watchlist WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND LOWER(name) = LOWER(#{name})
mapper.update: UPDATE watchlist SET name = #{name}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE watchlist_id = #{watchlistId}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM watchlist_item WHERE watchlist_id = #{watchlistId} ORDER BY ticker_symbol ASC

SELECT wi.watchlist_id, wi.ticker_symbol, wi.added_at, wi.alert_direction, wi.alert_target_price, wi.alert_status, wi.alert_set_at, wi.alert_triggered_at, wi.alert_trigger_price, wi.alert_delivery FROM watchlist_item wi JOIN watchlist w ON w.watchlist_id = wi.watchlist_id WHERE w.account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY wi.watchlist_id ASC, wi.ticker_symbol ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO watchlist_item ( watchlist_id, ticker_symbol, added_at ) SELECT CAST(#{item.watchlistId} AS BIGINT), CAST(#{item.tickerSymbol} AS VARCHAR), CAST(#{item.addedAt} AS TIMESTAMPTZ) WHERE ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM watchlist_item WHERE watchlist_id = #{item.watchlistId} ) < #{limit}
mapper.select: SELECT instrument_ticker FROM instrument WHERE UPPER(instrument_ticker) = UPPER(#{tickerSymbol}) AND instrument_status = 'TRADING'
mapper.update: UPDATE watchlist_item SET alert_direction = #{direction}, alert_target_price = #{targetPrice}, alert_status = 'ACTIVE', alert_set_at = #{setAt}, alert_triggered_at = NULL, alert_trigger_price = NULL, alert_delivery = NULL, alert_delivery_attempts = 0 WHERE watchlist_id = #{watchlistId} AND ticker_symbol = #{tickerSymbol} AND ( alert_status = 'ACTIVE' OR ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM watchlist_item wi JOIN watchlist w ON w.watchlist_id = wi.watchlist_id WHERE w.account_id = #{accountId} AND wi.alert_status = 'ACTIVE' ) < #{limit} )

UPDATE watchlist_item SET alert_direction = NULL, alert_target_price = NULL, alert_status = NULL, alert_set_at = NULL, alert_triggered_at = NULL, alert_trigger_price = NULL, alert_delivery = NULL, alert_delivery_attempts = 0 WHERE watchlist_id = #{watchlistId} AND UPPER(ticker_symbol) = UPPER(#{tickerSymbol}) AND alert_status IS NOT NULL
mapper.select: SELECT watchlist_id, ticker_symbol, alert_direction, alert_target_price FROM watchlist_item WHERE alert_status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT wi.watchlist_id, w.account_id, wi.ticker_symbol, wi.alert_direction, wi.alert_target_price, wi.alert_trigger_price, wi.alert_triggered_at, wi.alert_delivery_attempts FROM watchlist_item wi JOIN watchlist w ON w.watchlist_id = wi.watchlist_id WHERE wi.watchlist_id = #{watchlistId} AND wi.ticker_symbol = #{tickerSymbol} AND wi.alert_status = 'TRIGGERED'

SELECT wi.watchlist_id, w.account_id, wi.ticker_symbol, wi.alert_direction, wi.alert_target_price, wi.alert_trigger_price, wi.alert_triggered_at, wi.alert_delivery_attempts FROM watchlist_item wi JOIN watchlist w ON w.watchlist_id = wi.watchlist_id WHERE wi.alert_status = 'TRIGGERED' AND wi.alert_delivery IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED') AND wi.alert_delivery_attempts < #{maxAttempts} AND wi.alert_triggered_at < #{firedBefore} ORDER BY wi.alert_triggered_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}
